root_cause: Historical VERIFIED status and a database update timestamp do not establish recency of independently captured supplier claims. A fourteen-day automatic recommendation eligibility window can outlive the canonical seven-day freshness requirement.
prevention: Fail closed on stale, missing, impossible or independently unreviewed supplier claim receipts and do not conflate updated_at with source truth; keep daily learning independent of audit failure.
result_boundary: No supplier claims were reverified and no financial or customer outcomes were manufactured; production verified only after required CI, merge and exact deploy readback.
canonicalization_requirement: Executable historical replay required before fail-closed policy promotion. Required CI and exact production readback remain independent release gates.
